how: Anthropic, Effective harnesses for long-running agents (26.11.2025): one feature per session, the first whose passes is false unless his message names another; only 'passes' changes here, and only after npm test, the smoke test on GitHub, my own look in the headset or on the stand, and his yes to what he saw. His words for each feature are on the line of docs/board.md named in 'board'.

features.what: GitHub's smoke test green again: it looks at the corridor once door 1 is offered again after leaving a room by the menu
features.check: the test run on GitHub is green

features.what: Paintings on the corridor's end walls, swapping places on leaving a room
Floor directory by the stairs; two forms shown to him as pictures, he picks one
features.check: picture of both forms, then the chosen one in the headset; his yes

features.what: Light and gloom for the whole corridor at once, no lighting of its own on any object; room 101 after it
features.check: the corridor in the headset before and after; his yes

features.what: Fire extinguisher matched to his 19 photos of the 1970 WS-900
The signed consent form hangs on the board, filled in
The corridor's texts: a serious welcome, small dry details on paper; the start with the projector and the screen over the board
The first room: 2-3 trial rooms of 5 minutes, he picks one, then plays it whole
features.check: his yes after playing it whole

features.what: 5-10 testers from his community install through Meta's closed test channel; their records arrive
7 of 10 testers finish; their mean rating is 7 of 10 or more
features.check: the numbers from the testers' table

features.what: Release on the Meta Horizon Store
features.check: the store page live, on his word
